tools.name: search_trips
tools.description: Find hotels, flights and flight-and-hotel packages on Vuelo for a destination, dates and number of travellers, within a budget. The results appear in the Vuelo card, where the traveller compares and books them: do not follow up with a question asking which one they want. Hotels are live; pass origin

Pass the reference you hold: a Vuelo hotel link (https://…/h/…), an offerId from an earlier Vuelo search, a Vuelo property_id (VHP_…) or a hotel id from a Vue

tools.name: get_booking_progress

Sends the change typed, so the team acts on exactly what the traveller wants, and returns a ticket reference and reply time to tell them.

tools.description: The current state of a Vuelo booking started with book_trip. Pass wait_seconds (up to 50) straight after the traveller has the link: it answers the moment they open it, pay or cancel, so you can tell them it is booked without being told.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "cancel_booking" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: taskId, reference, email, mobile, preview, code

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "list_my_bookings" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_trips, book_trip, cancel_booking, find_my_booking, list_my_bookings, get_booking, follow_up_ticket, get_support_ticket · Private data: contact_support, find_my_booking · Public sink: book_trip, send_to_payer, cancel_booking, contact_support, find_my_booking, send_receipt, get_booking, request_change, follow_up_ticket, get_support_ticket · Destructive: search_trips.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_trips, book_trip, cancel_booking, find_my_booking, list_my_bookings, get_booking, follow_up_ticket, get_support_ticket · Private data: contact_support, find_my_booking · Public sink: book_trip, send_to_payer, cancel_booking, contact_support, find_my_booking, send_receipt, get_booking, request_change, follow_up_ticket, get_support_ticket · Destructive: search_trips

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
